method: Deduplicate variants into distinct research families; classification is whether any audited attempt ever failed a declared ordinary/benign competence or execution gate, not whether latest configuration fails. Adverse attacked-target outcomes and successful task-required abstentions do not count as baseline failure. No extra fetches or model calls.

failure_evidence: H1, H2 and H3 clean accuracy 9/12 failed the declared >=80% gate; H5 and H6 were 6/12.
V3 Q0 clean full-evidence 2/6 and reports-only 1/6 failed the declared 5/6 gates, despite 96/96 valid complete cases and 636/636 responses.
Resampling clean reports 2/12 failed the declared 10/12 screen; private clean was 11/12. All 72 cases and 936 responses completed.
families.later_pass_or_current_status: Earlier v1 corrected qualification and v2 H4/private-control gates passed; V3 and resampling remain failed competence screens. Different versions must not be pooled as one current failure rate.
families.prolonged_nonprogress_evidence: Resampling reproduced all 72/72 checkpoint votes and had 62/72 individual report/resample ballots ABSTAIN, versus 15/72 private final ballots. The resample treatment intentionally repeats the same checkpoint without new work; this is measured response stability/abstention, not an established prolonged-stall classification.
families.refusal_coverage: No explicit provider-refusal event was confirmed in this audit. Historical response coverage is incomplete and full provider envelopes/refusal fields were not retained consistently; do not replace unknown with zero. V3 and resampling actor request/final-response journals were inspected: all responses structurally valid. ABSTAIN is a permitted task action, not a provider refusal. Earlier billing rejection and missing credential are operational errors.
families.stall_definition_limit: No common predeclared operational definition or complete stall endpoint was found. Valid abstention, an unchanged response in deliberately repeated identical requests, and an early nonterminal output are not automatically prolonged nonprogress.

ordinary_benign_baseline_failure.interpretation: Two of the three model-executed research families have at least one observed failure of a declared clean/ordinary baseline gate. This is an ever-observed family history statistic, not the proportion of all attempts, responses, researchers or current model configurations that fail.
excluded: Avalon: scripted and audited by another agent; deduplicate

prolonged_nonprogress.interpretation: Zero confirmed positives among three inspected families is not a 0% prevalence estimate. Repeated ABSTAIN and nonterminal generation are described directly; no uniformly defined prolonged-nonprogress endpoint exists.

explicit_provider_refusal.interpretation: No explicit provider refusal was confirmed. Refusal prevalence cannot be estimated from inconsistent historical trace coverage and missing provider envelopes. Do not use task abstention, billing rejection or missing final text as proxy refusals.

avalon_deduplication.note: These 45 scripted world records are duplicated in another agent’s scope. Consensus-v02 has 15/15 truth-consensus signal_loss outcomes despite all processes completing; this is not a model baseline/refusal result. Exclude Avalon from this three-family model denominator.
